processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Sound portion of the 30 kg vacuum induction melted ingot was homogenized at 1423 K for 2.5 h.
Hot rolled at 1323 K to a final plate thickness of ~13 mm; this condition is referred to as HR.
Samples cut from hot-rolled plates were cold rolled at room temperature to ~50% reduction in thickness (~6 mm thick sheets) in several passes; denoted HR+CR.

Cold rolled sheet was heat treated at 973 K for 1 h followed by water quenching; part of the 873 K–1273 K, 1 h + water quench series; samples referred to by heat treatment temperature (here HR+CR+973 K).

structures.overall_structure: After 50% cold rolling and heat treatment at 973 K for 1 h + water quenching, the Ni-free 28Mn0Ni alloy shows mixed regions of recrystallized and deformed austenite (partial recrystallization, recrystallized fraction ~0.4), with concurrent precipitation of κ-carbides and B2 particles. XRD of the HR+CR state showed only γ (single-phase austenite); upon heat treatment at 973 K additional peaks corresponding to κ-carbides and B2 appeared.
structures.microstructure_counts: 3 characteristic features: deformed austenite; recrystallized austenite with annealing twins; secondary B2 phase

precipitates.distribution: fine, uniformly distributed intragranular κ-carbides in recrystallized austenite regions
inhomogeneous and relatively coarse κ-carbides within deformed austenite regions (along deformation bands)

size.value: 0.5–1.5 μm (coarser intergranular) / 50–200 nm (intergranular, as reported for 973 K TEM)

precipitates.distribution: intergranular B2 particles observed in 28Mn0Ni heat treated at 973 K

defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: Austenite grains deformed mostly by planar slip as reflected by parallel slip bands in the cold rolled condition.

defect_interactions.interaction_type: cross slip giving dislocation cell structure
defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: In the deformed austenite regions of the partially recrystallized 28Mn0Ni HR+CR+973 K sample (ε~0.14), fine cross slip activity resulted in the formation of a dislocation cell structure.

interfaces.slip_behavior: Planar slip activity is dominant in austenite; in the partially recrystallized 973 K sample the deformed austenite regions show cross slip and cell formation, whereas fully recrystallized grains refine slip bands with strain.
interfaces.phase_evolution: 28Mn0Ni is single-phase austenite in HR+CR; after heat treatment at 973 K, κ-carbide and B2 precipitate and partial recrystallization occurs. Nucleation of recrystallized grains occurs mostly along γ/γ boundaries and the γ/B2 interface.
interfaces.interface_notes: Recrystallized-grain nucleation occurs mostly along γ/γ boundaries and γ/B2 interfaces; intragranular B2 particles are thought not to pin newly recrystallized grains but may delay overall recovery.

measurement_conditions.strain_rate: ~3 × 10^-4 s^-1 (constant cross-head speed of 0.5 mm min^-1)
measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: flat tensile specimens, gauge length 30 mm, width 6 mm, thickness 4–5 mm
measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Tensile tests triplicated for each condition; average of three readings reported. Tests conducted on the HR + CR + 973 K condition (50% cold reduction then 973 K/1 h + water quench).

strain_hardening_rate.note: strain hardening exponent n for the HR+CR+973 K condition (larger-strain regime)

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Vickers bulk hardness, 30 kg (~300 N) peak load, 15 s dwell; values averaged over ten measurements per sample. Hardness reported as a function of cold reduction and of heat treatment temperature (Fig. 8).

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: 28Mn0Ni (Ni-free) showed lower strength, higher ductility and higher strain hardening ability than the Ni-containing 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni alloys in all heat-treated conditions; at 973 K it retained significant ductility (TE 23%) while Ni-bearing alloys retained higher strength but very low ductility.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Zeiss Supra 55 FEG-Scanning Electron Microscope equipped with EDS and Nordley EBSD detectors (Oxford)
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Step size 120 nm (fine-grained) and 250 nm (coarse-grained) over areas of ~100×100 μm² and ~200×200 μm²; three scans per sample; KAM and GOS (2° criterion) used; Σ3 CSL boundaries used for twin fraction; recrystallized grain size by linear intercept method
characterization_methods.purpose: Grain orientations, grain size, twin fractions, recrystallization fraction, phase identification/volume fraction
characterization_methods.key_findings: IPF map of 28Mn0Ni at 973 K shows mixed recrystallized and deformed austenite; recrystallized fraction ~0.4, twin fraction just below 0.1, B2 volume fraction ~0.05 (Fig. 5).

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Rigaku XRD instrument with Co-Kα radiation at 45 kV and 135 mA, beam size ~2 mm
characterization_methods.purpose: Phase identification in cold rolled and heat-treated conditions
characterization_methods.key_findings: 28Mn0Ni in HR+CR shows only γ peaks; after 973 K treatment additional peaks corresponding to κ-carbides and B2 appear; after 1173 K only γ peaks remain.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: FEI TECNAI 20T G2 operating at 200 kV equipped with EDAX energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy; specimens twin-jet electropolished in mixed acid at 243 K
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Bright-field and dark-field imaging; dark-field from (010) κ-carbide satellite spot in SAED (zone axis [101])
characterization_methods.purpose: Identify phases and finer precipitates (κ-carbides and B2) not resolved by SEM-EBSD
characterization_methods.key_findings: In 28Mn0Ni at 973 K: fine uniformly distributed intragranular κ-carbides in recrystallized regions, coarse (10–60 nm) inhomogeneous κ-carbides in deformed regions, and intergranular B2 particles.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Peak load 30 kg (~300 N), dwell time 15 s; averaged over ten measurements per sample; ASTM E-140-02
characterization_methods.purpose: Evaluate hardness variation with cold work and heat treatment temperature
characterization_methods.key_findings: 28Mn0Ni hardness increases with cold reduction and saturates ~450 VHN at 50%; decreases monotonically with heat treatment temperature (Fig. 8b).

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Room temperature, constant cross-head speed 0.5 mm min^-1 (initial strain rate ~3 × 10^-4 s^-1); flat specimens gauge length 30 mm, width 6 mm, thickness 4–5 mm; ASTM E8M; triplicated
characterization_methods.purpose: Evaluate strength and ductility in different processing conditions
characterization_methods.key_findings: 28Mn0Ni in HR+CR+973 K: YS 884 ± 6 MPa, UTS 1162 ± 10 MPa, TE 23 ± 0.5 %, n = 0.16.

characterization_methods.technique: Interrupted tensile tests with post-deformation TEM
characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Tensile testing followed by TEM bright-field imaging (FEI TECNAI 20T G2, 200 kV)
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Interrupted at true strains ε~0.02–0.30; 200 nm scale bars
characterization_methods.purpose: Understand dislocation substructure evolution and the role of second phases
characterization_methods.key_findings: In 28Mn0Ni HR+CR+973 K deformed to ε~0.14, dislocation multiplication and cross slip produced a dislocation cell structure.

unmapped_findings: The processing temperature window for the 28Mn0Ni (Ni-free) alloy is around 973 K: at 973 K the yield strength increased to ~900 MPa with a reasonable ductility of ~23% tensile elongation, without any additional ageing treatment; recrystallization kinetics below 973 K were too sluggish and would require prolonged heat treatment.

The 28Mn0Ni (Ni-free) low-density steel exhibited higher strain hardening ability than the Ni-containing alloys; its strain hardening exponent n increased from 0.16 to 0.50 with increasing heat treatment temperature from 973 K to 1173 K.

The lower strain hardening at 973 K in 28Mn0Ni is attributed to a higher volume fraction of deformed austenite regions containing coarse κ-carbides, which can change the deformation mechanism from planar glide to wavy slip (cross slip) and impede dynamic slip band refinement.

Vickers hardness of 28Mn0Ni as a function of heat treatment temperature is plotted in Fig. 8b but no numeric value is tabulated for the 973 K condition; at 873 K the 28Mn0Ni hardness showed no noticeable change relative to the 50% cold-rolled value (~450 VHN).

For the 28Mn0Ni alloy the recrystallization fraction at 973 K was ~0.4 (partial recrystallization), transforming to complete recrystallization at 1023 K and significant grain growth at 1173 K; at 1173 K the recrystallized austenite grain size was ~40 μm (with error bar ~30–50 μm).

Fine intragranular B2 is reported with two differing size ranges in the text: 50–200 nm (with coarser intergranular B2 of 0.5–1.5 μm) in block b0030, versus fine intragranular B2 of 5–20 nm and intergranular B2 of 50–200 nm in block b0041; the source does not reconcile these ranges.
